answer.origin: NVIDIA Corporation, Form 8-K filed with the SEC on August 17, 2026; the company is the originating speaker, and the report date and stated event date are August 17, 2026.
answer.note: NVIDIA reported that it entered multiple residual-value guaranties with SB Energy covering leases for approximately 4.25 GW of IT load at the Portsmouth Site. NVIDIA says the site is intended to host its AI compute infrastructure, with OpenAI as tenant deploying NVIDIA’s DSX AI factory platform. The stated aggregate payment obligation for the initial commitment is cumulatively capped at $105 billion; the guaranties generally become effective when the applicable leases commence, and payment is conditional, including on OpenAI insolvency causing a lease default or failure to pay and the lessor meeting applicable ready-for-service conditions, expected to begin in 2028. Payment generally covers a shortfall against a guaranteed minimum lease value after replacement leasing or sale recoveries. OpenAI has agreed to reimburse and indemnify amounts NVIDIA actually pays. NVIDIA may, at its sole discretion, provide credit support for approximately 3.8 GW of additional capacity; that is not part of the stated initial commitment. The filing supports a substantial, conditional contingent obligation for NVIDIA and a planned large-scale deployment of NVIDIA infrastructure by OpenAI, but does not establish that a guarantee payment will occur, that all capacity will be delivered or used, or the timing or amount of related NVIDIA product sales. The indemnity may mitigate NVIDIA’s net cost but does not remove the stated contingent exposure.
limitations: The filing says its description is incomplete and that the form of the guaranties will be filed with NVIDIA’s Form 10-Q for the fiscal quarter ended July 26, 2026; the full contractual terms and detailed calculation mechanics are not included here.
The filing does not disclose whether the applicable leases have commenced, whether ready-for-service conditions have been met, or whether any trigger event or payment has occurred.

The $105 billion figure is a cumulative cap, not an estimate of expected payments; the filing does not quantify likely exposure or the timing and amount of any NVIDIA hardware sales associated with the planned deployment.
follow_up: Review the referenced Form 10-Q exhibit for the full guaranty terms, lease-level conditions, and termination provisions.

Check subsequent NVIDIA filings for lease commencement and ready-for-service status, any OpenAI payment default, guarantee payments or recognized exposure, and reimbursement or indemnification amounts.
Track company disclosures on actual Portsmouth capacity delivery and OpenAI deployment of NVIDIA systems, separately from the announced capacity and intended platform use.

proposal.question: What exposure from NVIDIA’s undertaken Portsmouth residual-value guaranties will be reported at its next annual filing?
proposal.settled_by: NVIDIA’s next annual filing after August 17, 2026, checking its disclosure of any payments or recognized liability and the status of the undertaken guaranties.
proposal.lost_if_folded: Folding this into a general data-center demand question would lose separate tracking of NVIDIA’s own capped, conditional contingent obligation and any resulting reported exposure.
